translations.web: This is the reward of my adversaries from Yahweh, of those who speak evil against my soul.
translations.bsb: May this be the LORD’s reward to my accusers, to those who speak evil against me.
translations.kjv: Let this be the reward of mine adversaries from the LORD, and of them that speak evil against my soul.
translations.asv: This is the reward of mine adversaries from Jehovah, And of them that speak evil against my soul.
